Theme

Latin word

angustus

angustus, angusta, angustum

declension

narrow, cramped; narrow; petty, narrow-minded

In this lexicon

  • narrow

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 21.35.12: via praeceps, angusta, lūbrica; Caes. B.C. 1.25: faucēs portūs angustissimae (Lewis & Short); Traupman 205, 349

  • narrow-minded

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 1.68: nihil est tam angustī animī, tam parvī, quam amāre dīvitiās (Lewis & Short); Traupman 156

Examples

  • omnis enim fermē via praeceps, angusta, lūbrica erat

    for nearly the whole way was steep, narrow and slipperyLiv. 21.35.11–12

    In the entry for narrow

    and more often the ant, wearing a narrow track, has carried her eggs out of her inner chambersVerg. G. 1.379–380

    In the entry for narrow

  • quaesō, tam angustam tālis vir pōnis domum?

    please, are you, a man like you, building so cramped a house?Phaedr. 3.9.6

    In the entry for narrow

  • angustī animī esse

    to be narrow-mindedTraupman 349
